:::{#exr-linear-is-affine-practice}
#### Testing whether a linear score is an affine map

A model whose output is $0$ at $\vx = \vzero$ is still an [affine map](#def-affine-map),
which matters when a result is stated only for affine maps.
Let $f: \reals^2 \to \reals$ be $f(\vx) = x_1 - 4 x_2$,
a [linear map](#def-linear-map).

Is $f$ an [affine map](#def-affine-map)?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Use @cor-linear-is-affine.
